title: Foreign Ministry Flagged in Audit Over Apostille Fees
excerpt: The Auditor General of Pakistan has pointed out irregularities regarding the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' increase in Apostille certification.
body_html:
The Auditor General of Pakistan has raised concerns regarding the Ministry of Foreign Affairs over financial and operational irregularities.

Specifically, the audit flagged issues linked to an increase in Apostille certification fees implemented by the ministry.

Further details regarding the exact nature of the financial discrepancies or the scale of the irregularities were not immediately detailed in the findings.
